NUMBER:

AUTHOR:
Abraham Lincoln
 (1809–1865)
 
QUOTATION:
  In giving freedom to the slave we assure freedom to the free,—honorable alike in what we give and what we preserve.
 
ATTRIBUTION:
Second Annual Message to Congress, Dec. 1, 1862.
